# Deadline announcement

Send to the channels listed under
[Communicate major deadlines](../release-timeline.md#communicate-major-deadlines)
at least a week before each docs deadline. State deadlines in Anywhere on
Earth (AoE) time plus the UTC equivalent.

```text
Hello KEP and docs owners! <future release> Docs team here.

The <deadline name, for example docs placeholder PR deadline> is <day, date> (AoE) / <day, date>, 12:00 UTC.

That means if you have a <future release> enhancement that requires docs, SIG Docs requires that by then <what is required, for example: you have at the very least a PR opened against the `dev-<future release>` branch in the kubernetes/website repo>.

<Optional encouragement, for example: It would be awesome if it's the full doc!>

Important dates for <future release>: https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/blob/master/releases/release-<future release>/README.md#summary
```
